outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic and micrograph illustrations of image cropping/rotation/resizing, not a quantitative plot.
Panel b shows schematic and micrograph illustrations of image spacing in figures, not a quantitative plot.
Panel c shows schematic and micrograph illustrations of insets/magnifications, not a quantitative plot.
Panel d shows micrographs illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment, not a quantitative plot.
Panel e shows micrographs and schematic circles illustrating channel annotation visibility, not a quantitative plot.
Panel f shows micrographs and schematics illustrating grayscale channel display, not a quantitative plot.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity scale bars, not a quantitative plot requiring individual data points.
